test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting on a straight bench facing towards east. P is sitting exactly at the middle position. Only four friends are sitting to the left of M. Only Q is sitting between R and S. O is sitting third to the right of S. Who is sitting at the second place from the right end?
solution:
Seven friends **M, N, O, P, Q, R and S** are sitting on a straight bench facing towards east.

1. P is sitting exactly at the middle position.

2. Only four friends are sitting to the left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749acfeebbca5a55f6f6e69966629f94e57c49cf3954617b81a59ee0cb529590.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04a8b70eacbcfbc40369628a100b3888fb2ea6f8f779c991c9902e02622135c8.png] 

3. Only Q is sitting between R and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37c7bf8430500776e72cb1b6f9fba80249b058cdac5c32c4f2e4c29238fef7da.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09420a4a6c6db9bfdc00c81199c614d0faebfa2d4f686534b44bf19691008902.png] 

4. O is sitting third to the right of S.

The above condition can be satisfied only when R is sitting at the extreme end and S is sitting between Q and P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86770be21af19e272704592be2b8a273efcbe0de91357c6f100925d82d65aeef.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55dd3b05eadd4727eec3d6ed1f359c3a034132be1f3c39cf8614d47d44403d4e.png] 

Clearly, N the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfdb46320e9208a666d053da27e7fd68d4325e22f4ca9f09ff7d1d49a2e1ee0c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10445c78e12f650fed635af8ece0cdc0e3956f14dcc6bb85ffd2373eac1b2bd2.png] 

Therefore, O is sitting at the second place from the right end.

Hence,** 'O' **is the correct answer.
